address: 71 Nile Street, Shoreditch, London, N1 7RD, United Kingdom
bio: What was once a well-known local boozer is now a swish dining experience complete with a tasting menu and a Spanish marble counter. Dinner is served to all guests at 7.15pm, so be sure to arrive on time or you’ll miss out on the boldly flavoured, modern British cooking. Cornish seafood and Lancashire Goosnargh duck are among the top quality ingredients on offer, and are brought to life using mostly classic combinations. The bar stays open late, so a post-dinner cocktail is always on the cards....
